spreadCalibration.productionRule: 3.0+ model-vs-market points = high-priority model audit/research, not automatic bet; 1.5-2.5 = watch/research.

inSeasonPriorDecay.method: walk-forward scoring-margin blend; each historical week uses only prior weeks
inSeasonPriorDecay.note: Use smoothed phase weights rather than noisy single-week optima. Re-run with EPA/player/availability live rating architecture once sufficient historical reconstruction is available.

totalsCalibration.productionRule: Historical scoring-only totals are baseline forecasts, not betting signals. No total can be promoted from this layer alone; 2026 QB/OL/skill/pace/weather/matchup features must be incorporated and revalidated.

teamSpecificHFA.rule: Require >0.03 point MAE improvement before team-specific HFA can replace generic baseline. Validation failed this requirement, so team-specific HFA remains diagnostic only.

source: nflverse schedule/results/closing-line data; calibration executed in nfl-betting-intelligence GitHub Actions
caveats: Historical structural spread backtest does not reconstruct all QB/roster/coaching changes.
ATS threshold results use closing lines diagnostically and are not independent holdout validation.
Rolling score-margin calibration is architecture guidance; production live ratings will use EPA/player/availability data.
Totals threshold diagnostics do not support betting from the baseline totals model alone.
